observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT
Safety: CAUTION
Issues: Lateral-only radiograph cannot reliably establish catheter laterality; the visible “L” is a projection/cassette marker, not a device-side marker; no clear insertion site or course distinguishes right from left; catheter presence itself is not unequivocally clear on this single view
Suggestion: Confirm laterality on a frontal chest radiograph or from the insertion-site/procedure record before accepting “right indwelling catheter.”
